title: Planting the Bean Row

readiness.math: counting to 3; comparing lengths with a non-standard unit
readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Here is our bean row. Bean plants grow big and leafy, so each one needs room.

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: This stick is our helper. Each bean needs one stick of space, starting from the stone.

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Put a peg one stick away from the stone. Then one stick away from that peg, and so on. Lay the stick down to measure.
steps.hint: Lay the stick next to the stone. Where does the other end reach? Put a peg there.

feedback.placed_all: Now let's check with the stick. Does it fit each space?
feedback.crowded: Look: the stick covers a peg there. Those beans would be too close. Can that peg move further away?
feedback.far: Look: there's a gap past the end of the stick. Can that peg move closer?
feedback.all_good: Every space is one stick long. The beans will have room to grow.

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Now three seeds in each hole. Count as you drop them in: one, two, three.
steps.hint: Find a hole with an empty little dip and put a seed there.

feedback.full: That hole already has three seeds. Try a hole with an empty dip.
feedback.all_good: Three, three, three, three. Every hole has its seeds.

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: Now we tuck them in with soil, like a warm blanket. Sun and rain will do the rest.

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: Come, let's look at our row.

journal_line: I planted a row of beans with Miriam. I measured the spaces with a stick and put three seeds in each hole.
unavailable_text: The bean row is already planted. Now it needs sun, rain and time.
